difficulty.label: basic_learning
difficulty.rationale: Correct answer 1.90 atm. Requires recognizing that each gas expands into the total 5 L at constant T and n, so P1V1 = P2V2 per gas (Ar: 2×4/5 = 1.6 atm; CH4: 1.5×1/5 = 0.3 atm), then summing the partial pressures (Dalton). It has two simple proportional calculations and one addition, with no unit conversions, no table or graph reading, and short wording. Distractors reflect common errors (summing the initial pressures, reporting only the Ar partial pressure). It is a standard single-concept application, appropriate for learning rather than a full-mock challenge.
